title: kith-chat: Message/set invalidProperties error missing properties array
description: Message/set process_update returns {"type":"invalidProperties","description":"only readAt is patchable"} without the required "properties" array. RFC 8620 §5.3 specifies SetError of type invalidProperties MUST include a properties array listing the offending property names. The contact handler correctly includes "properties": [key]. The message handler does not. Fix: capture the unknown key in the for-loop body and include "properties": [key] in the error, matching the contact handler pattern.
